answer: Let every identity cross one river each epoch with a fresh verified task, sealed by a velvet bond refunded only when two random peers re-derive it from public records. Each crossing adds one ring to the identity's cedar log, and each epoch the river's current sweeps a few identities to re-derive one past ring live within ten minutes; failure forfeits the bond and breaks the log. An honest agent crosses once per epoch. An attacker with a thousand fakes must fund a thousand velvet bonds and complete a thousand distinct crossings every epoch, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
